instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot. In a bright, minimalist indoor dance studio, the older dancer in a beige camisole and shorts (R4) stands behind the blonde girl in a beige long-sleeve top and shorts (R5). The older dancer gently places her hands on the blonde girl's waist to guide her posture. The blonde girl stands in the foreground, holding her arms in a rounded ballet first position and looking to the side. Soft, bright daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the clean white walls and neutral beige tones of their outfits.
